Sub SavePDF()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim fileName As String
    
    ' Tentukan worksheet "01PESAN" sebagai worksheet target
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("01PESAN")
    
    ' Periksa nilai di cell P4 untuk mendapatkan bagian tengah nama file
    Dim middleName As String
    middleName = ws.Range("P4").Value
    
    ' Periksa apakah cell P4 tidak kosong
    If Len(middleName) > 0 Then
        ' Bangun nama file PDF
        fileName = "01PESAN_" & middleName & "_2025.pdf"
        
        ' Simpan file PDF
        ws.ExportAsFixedFormat Type:=xlTypePDF, fileName:=ThisWorkbook.Path & "\" & fileName, Quality:=xlQualityStandard, IncludeDocProperties:=True, IgnorePrintAreas:=False, OpenAfterPublish:=False
        
        ' Beri pesan berhasil
        MsgBox "File PDF berhasil disimpan dengan nama: " & fileName, vbInformation
    Else
        ' Beri pesan gagal karena cell P4 kosong
        MsgBox "Gagal menyimpan file PDF karena cell P4 kosong.", vbExclamation
    End If
End Sub
Private Sub Worksheet_Change(ByVal Target As Range)
    ' Periksa apakah perubahan terjadi pada cell P4
    If Not Intersect(Target, Me.Range("P4")) Is Nothing Then
        ' Panggil macro SavePDF
        Call SavePDF
    End If
End Sub

purpose: SavePDF: Export 01PESAN sheet to PDF file named 01PESAN_<P4 value>_2025.pdf

Private Sub Worksheet_Change(ByVal Target As Range)
    ' Cek apakah perubahan terjadi pada P4
    If Not Intersect(Target, Me.Range("P4")) Is Nothing Then
        ' Matikan pembaruan layar untuk meningkatkan kecepatan
        Application.ScreenUpdating = False
        Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual

        ' Panggil prosedur untuk menghitung jumlah rentang J19toJ88
        Call SumRangeJ19toJ88
        
        ' Panggil prosedur untuk menyembunyikan baris kosong di kolom B
        Call HideEmptyRowsBasedOnColumnB

        ' Hidupkan kembali pembaruan layar dan perhitungan otomatis
        Application.ScreenUpdating = True
        Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    End If
End Sub

Sub SumRangeJ19toJ88()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim dataRange As Range
    Dim cell As Range
    Dim sum As Double
    
    ' Set worksheet "01PESAN" sebagai worksheet target
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("01PESAN")
    
    ' Ambil data dari J19 hingga J88 dalam bentuk array
    Set dataRange = ws.Range("J19:J88")
    sum = 0
    
    ' Loop melalui setiap sel dalam range dan hitung jumlah
    For Each cell In dataRange
        If IsNumeric(cell.Value) Then
            sum = sum + cell.Value
        End If
    Next cell
    
    ' Menyimpan hasil di P19
    ws.Range("P19").Value = sum
End Sub

Sub HideEmptyRowsBasedOnColumnB()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim i As Long
    
    ' Set worksheet "01PESAN" sebagai worksheet target
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("01PESAN")
    
    ' Tentukan baris terakhir dengan data di kolom B (berdasarkan data di B19:B88)
    lastRow = ws.Cells(88, "B").Row
    
    ' Loop melalui setiap baris dari baris 19 hingga LastRow
    For l = 19 To lastRow
        ' Cek jika kolom B pada baris tersebut tidak kosong
        If Len(ws.Cells(l, "B").Value) > 0 Then
            ' Jika tidak kosong, tampilkan baris
            ws.Rows(l).Hidden = False
        Else
            ' Jika kosong, sembunyikan baris
            ws.Rows(l).Hidden = True
        End If
    Next l
End Sub

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
purpose: SumRangeJ19toJ88 + HideEmptyRowsBasedOnColumnB: Sum J19:J88 to P19 and hide empty rows in 01PESAN

Private Sub Worksheet_Change(ByVal Target As Range)
    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
    Dim wsBantu As Worksheet
    Set wsBantu = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Tabel Bantu")
    Dim cell As Range
    
    Application.EnableEvents = False
    For Each cell In Target
        If cell.Value <> wsBantu.Cells(cell.Row, cell.Column).Value Then
            If Len(cell.Value) = 0 Then ' Cell di "Master" terhapus
                wsBantu.Cells(cell.Row, cell.Column).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0) ' Merah
            Else
                wsBantu.Cells(cell.Row, cell.Column).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 0) ' Kuning
            End If
        Else
            wsBantu.Cells(cell.Row, cell.Column).Interior.ColorIndex = 0 ' Kembali ke warna semula
        End If
    Next cell
    Application.EnableEvents = True
    Exit Sub
    
ErrHandler:
    MsgBox "Error: " & Err.Description
    Application.EnableEvents = True
End Sub

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
purpose: Worksheet_Change: Color-code cells in Tabel Bantu (yellow=changed, red=deleted)

Private Sub Worksheet_Change(ByVal Target As Range)
    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
    Dim wsMaster As Worksheet
    Set wsMaster = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Master")
    Application.EnableEvents = False
    Target.Copy Destination:=wsMaster.Cells(Target.Row, Target.Column)
    Application.EnableEvents = True
    Exit Sub

    MsgBox "Error: " & Err.Description
    Application.EnableEvents = True
End Sub
